name: Tripwire
description: Born from a destroyed security perimeter AI. Creates invisible digital boundaries — step across and your augments briefly fritz. Cross back and they stabilize.
observed_behavior: Maintains virtual perimeters in physical space using localized EM interference. The boundaries are consistent and mappable but serve no apparent purpose.
story_hooks: Someone maps all of Tripwire's boundaries and realizes they outline the perimeter of a facility that was demolished — the E.L.F. is guarding a building that doesn't exist anymore
